version.changelog:
- Synchronize version numbering between skill metadata and documentation.
- No code logic or endpoint changes included.

llm.summary: The skill is mostly coherent for a read-only financial integration, but small inconsistencies (domains, an undeclared environment variable, and an npm postinstall that writes into your home directory) merit caution before installing.

dimensions.detail: The name/description (Shelter: connect to financial data, safe-to-spend, forecasts, coaching) align with the declared requirement of a single API key and curl-based calls to a JSON API. However there are inconsistent domain references (shelterfinance.com, shelter.money, and api.shelterfinance.com appear in different files) which should be verified as legitimate aliases of the same service.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs only to make read-only HTTP calls (curl) to specific endpoints and to interpret the returned JSON; it does not request broad system reads or unrelated credentials. One inconsistency: SKILL.md frequently references an environment variable SHELTER_API_URL (with a default) and says to confirm it's set, but the registry metadata's required env list only includes SHELTER_API_KEY; the instructions do not try to read other local files. This mismatch is a minor scope incoherence.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no remote binary download; the package contains install-skill.js which is run via package.json's postinstall. install-skill.js copies SKILL.md and the references/ directory into ~/.claude/skills/shelter (or a project .claude path). Writing into the user's home directory is expected for skill installation but is a real modification to disk and will occur automatically when npm postinstall runs — users should be aware of this side effect.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill only requires a single credential (SHELTER_API_KEY), which matches its function as an API client. No other secrets are requested. Note: SKILL.md also mentions SHELTER_API_URL (optional/defaulted) but it is not declared as required — this is a minor documentation/inventory mismatch, not an extra secret demand.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request 'always: true' and does not modify other skills or system-wide agent settings. Its install/uninstall scripts act only on a skill directory under the user (or project) .claude path.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to be a standard read-only connector to a financial API, but check a few things before installing: 1) Verify the official Shelter domain(s) and where you should create API keys — files mention both shelter.money and shelterfinance.com (confirm they’re the same legitimate service). 2) Installing the npm package will run a postinstall script that copies files into ~/.claude/skills — if you prefer manual control, copy SKILL.md yourself instead of running the package installer. 3) The runtime docs reference SHELTER_API_URL (with a default) but the registry only declares SHELTER_API_KEY; ensure you understand which base URL will be used and that you only provide the API key you intend to share. If you want higher assurance, ask the publisher for a canonical support URL or verify the GitHub repository indicated in package.json before proceeding.
